CREATE procedure [dbo].[SCM0001_GET_TEAM_BY_DIVISION]
  @p_division_id NVARCHAR(18)
AS
BEGIN
	
  SELECT DISTINCT 
         B.DEPT_ID       AS CODE
       , B.DEPT_NAME_KO  AS NAME
  FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE]          A  WITH(NOLOCK)
       , [dbo].[SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO] B  WITH(NOLOCK)
  WHERE  A.SITE_TYPE = 'SALES'
  AND    A.DEPT_ID  = B.DEPT_ID
  AND    CASE WHEN @p_division_id = 'ALL' THEN 'ALL'
                ELSE A.DIVISION_ID
	       END  IN (SELECT t.c.value('.', 'NVARCHAR(4000)')
                    FROM   (SELECT x = CAST('<t>' + REPLACE(@p_division_id, ',', '</t><t>') + '</t>' AS xml)) b
                    CROSS APPLY x.nodes('/t') t(c)
	               )
	;

END

/*
 * Program ID   : SCM0001_GET_WEEK_MONDAY_PERIOD
 * Description  : PERIOD 일자별 기간조회 (조회시점 월요일 기준)
 * Program History
 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge		Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2019/09/06   YWH				Initial Release [PJ20189106] 전지GSCM 고도화

 ex)
 EXEC SCM0001_GET_SCP_PERIOD @p_from_date='20180417', @p_offset_month='12',@p_timezone='AM073'
 */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCM0001_GET_WEEK_MONDAY_PERIOD]
	 @p_from_date    NVARCHAR(30) 
	,@p_offset_day   INT
	,@p_timezone     NVARCHAR(200) 
AS

BEGIN
	IF ISNULL(@p_from_date,'')='' 
		SET @p_from_date = CONVERT(CHAR(8), DATEADD(DD, -7, dbo.FN_NEXT_DAY(GETDATE(), 'MON')), 112);
		--SET @p_from_date = convert(varchar(8), [dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_timezone),112);
		
	IF ISNULL(@p_offset_day,'')='' 
		SET @p_offset_day = '370'
	
	IF CHARINDEX('-',@p_offset_day) = 1
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) + ':' + MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
			FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
			WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= @p_from_date
			 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(varchar(8) , DATEADD(DAY, @p_offset_day, @p_from_date), 112)
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) + ':' + MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
			FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
			WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= @p_from_date
			 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= CONVERT(varchar(8) , DATEADD(DAY, @p_offset_day, @p_from_date), 112)
		END

END

/*

 * Description  : Calendar Week 조회

 *
 */
create PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCM0001_GET_CALENDAR_WEEK]
  
@p_from_yyyymmdd  NVARCHAR(MAX),
@p_to_yyyymmdd    NVARCHAR(MAX) 

AS
BEGIN
	
    SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SELECT 
		 q.basis_yyyymmdd
		,q.week_name
	FROM scm_sys_calendar_m q with(nolock)	
	WHERE 1=1
	AND q.basis_yyyymmdd >= @p_from_yyyymmdd
	AND q.basis_yyyymmdd <= @p_to_yyyymmdd
 
    ;

END

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCM0001_GET_LOCATION_BY_PLANTSITE]  
  @p_division_id    NVARCHAR(MAX),
  @p_scm_site_id    NVARCHAR(MAX)
AS
BEGIN
	
  SET NOCOUNT ON;
    
  SELECT 
	     L.LOCATION_CODE AS CODE
	   , L.LOCATION_DESCRIPTION AS NAME
  FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_LOCATION] L WITH(NOLOCK)	
  WHERE 1=1
  AND    L.LOCATION_CODE = L.LOCATION_CODE
  AND    L.STORAGE_ID IS NOT NULL
  AND    (@p_division_id IS NULL OR L.DIVISION_ID IN 
				(SELECT t.c.value('.', 'NVARCHAR(4000)')
				FROM   (SELECT x = CAST('<t>' + REPLACE(@p_division_id, ',', '</t><t>') + '</t>' AS xml)) b
				CROSS APPLY x.nodes('/t') t(c)
				)

				(SELECT t.c.value('.', 'NVARCHAR(4000)')
				FROM   (SELECT x = CAST('<t>' + REPLACE(@p_scm_site_id, ',', '</t><t>') + '</t>' AS xml)) b
				CROSS APPLY x.nodes('/t') t(c)
				)   
	     )

 * Description  : PERIOD 일자별 기간조회 
 * Program History

 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/04/19   ygkim		   Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트

 ex)
 EXEC SCM0001_GET_SCP_PERIOD @p_from_date='20180417', @p_offset_month='12',@p_timezone='AM073'
 */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCM0001_GET_SCP_DAY_PERIOD]
	 @p_from_date    NVARCHAR(30) 
	,@p_offset_day   INT
	,@p_timezone     NVARCHAR(200) 
AS

BEGIN
	IF ISNULL(@p_from_date,'')='' 
		SET @p_from_date = convert(varchar(8), [dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_timezone),112);
		
	IF ISNULL(@p_offset_day,'')='' 
		SET @p_offset_day = '6'
	
	IF CHARINDEX('-',@p_offset_day) = 1
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) + ':' + MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
			FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
			WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= @p_from_date
			 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= CONVERT(varchar(8) , DATEADD(DAY, @p_offset_day, @p_from_date), 112)
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT
				MIN(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) + ':' + MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD)
			FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A
			WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= @p_from_date
			 AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= CONVERT(varchar(8) , DATEADD(DAY, @p_offset_day, @p_from_date), 112)
		END

END

/*
 * Program ID   : SCM0001_GET_SCP_MONTH_PERIOD
 * Description  : PERIOD 기간조회 SCM_MST_PLAN 테이블에서 가져옴(공용)
 * Program History

 *===================================================================================================
 *   Date       In Charge      Description
 *===================================================================================================
 * 2018/06/01   ygkim		   Initial Release [PJ20170278] 전지본부 자동차 GSCM(DM/SCP) 구축 프로젝트
 * 2021/05/27   khj79          [PJ20209642] LGES Digital SCM Level.3 달성을 위한 개선 - 중장기
 * 

 ex)
 EXEC SCM0001_GET_SCP_MONTH_PERIOD @p_division_id='81', @p_plan_cycle = 'WEEKLY', @p_from_date = '20180604', @p_offset_month='12',@p_timezone='AM073'
 */

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[SCM0001_GET_SCP_MONTH_PERIOD]
	 @p_division_id    NVARCHAR(max) 
	,@p_plan_cycle	   NVARCHAR(max) 
	,@p_from_date    NVARCHAR(30) 
	,@p_offset_month NVARCHAR(2) 	
	,@p_timezone       NVARCHAR(200) 
AS

BEGIN
	
	DECLARE @n_chk INT
	SET @n_chk = 0;

	SELECT @n_chk = count(*)
	FROM SCM_MST_PLAN WITH(NOLOCK)
	WHERE DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id
	  AND PLAN_CYCLE = 'WEEKLY'
	  AND PLAN_NAME = @p_from_date;

	IF @n_chk > 0
		BEGIN
			-- 2021-05-27 : 중장기
			--SELECT PLAN_NAME +':'+HORIZON_END_DATE
			--FROM SCM_MST_PLAN
			--WHERE DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id
			--  AND PLAN_CYCLE = 'WEEKLY'
			--  AND PLAN_NAME = @p_from_date;
			SELECT PLAN_NAME +':'+ CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), DATEADD(D, 363, CONVERT(DATE, PLAN_NAME)), 112)
			  FROM SCM_MST_PLAN
			 WHERE DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id
			   AND PLAN_CYCLE = 'WEEKLY'
			   AND PLAN_NAME = @p_from_date;
		END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			IF ISNULL(@p_from_date,'')='' 
				SET @p_from_date = convert(varchar(8), [dbo].[FN_MULTY_TIME](@p_timezone),112);
		
			IF ISNULL(@p_offset_month,'')='' 
				SET @p_offset_month = '12'

			-- MAX일자는 해당주의 뒷 일요일 구함
			SELECT MIN_BASIS_YYYYMMDD +':'+MAX_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
			FROM (
					SELECT MIN_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
						  ,DATEPART(DW,MIN_BASIS_YYYYMMDD ) AS MIN_PART
						  --,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(DATETIME, MAX_BASIS_YYYYMMDD )+ 7-DATEPART(DW,MAX_BASIS_YYYYMMDD )+1,112)  AS MAX_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
						  ,CONVERT(VARCHAR, CONVERT(DATETIME, MAX_BASIS_YYYYMMDD )-DATEPART(DW,MAX_BASIS_YYYYMMDD )+1,112)  AS MAX_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
						  ,DATEPART(DW,MAX_BASIS_YYYYMMDD ) AS MAX_PART
					 FROM (	SELECT MIN(A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD) AS MIN_BASIS_YYYYMMDD , MAX(BASIS_YYYYMMDD) AS MAX_BASIS_YYYYMMDD
							  FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M A  WITH(NOLOCK)
							 WHERE A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= @p_from_date
							   AND A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= CONVERT(varchar(8) , DATEADD(MM, convert(int,@p_offset_month), @p_from_date), 112)
						  ) T
				  ) U
			END
END

       , A.SCM_SITE_ID
       , A.CITY
       , A.COUNTRY
	   , A.PLANT_ID
	   , A.OPERATION_GROUP
	   , D.DEPT_ID
	   , D.DEPT_NAME_KO
	   , T.DEPT_ID       AS TEAM_ID
	   , T.DEPT_NAME_KO  AS TEAM_NAME_KO
	   , SC.SOLDTO_CODE

	   , SC.SHIPTO_CODE

	   , A.VALID_YN

  FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SITE]             A  WITH(NOLOCK)
         LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO  T  WITH(NOLOCK)
	       ON A.DEPT_ID = T.DEPT_ID
	     LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_SSO_DEPT_INFO  D  WITH(NOLOCK)
	       ON T.UPPER_DEPT_ID = D.DEPT_ID
	    LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM_MST_SITE_CUSTOMER AS SC  WITH(NOLOCK)
	       ON (    A.DIVISION_ID = SC.DIVISION_ID
	           AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = SC.SCM_SITE_ID
	           AND SC.REP_YN = 'Y' )
		LEFT JOIN SCM_MST_CUSTOMER  AS C  WITH(NOLOCK)
		  ON (    SC.DIVISION_ID = C.DIVISION_ID
		      AND SC.SOLDTO_CODE = C.SOLDTO_CODE
		      AND SC.SHIPTO_CODE = C.SHIPTO_CODE
			 )
  WHERE  1 = 1
  AND    A.SITE_TYPE     = 'SALES'
  AND    CASE WHEN @p_division_id = 'ALL' THEN @p_division_id

 	               END  IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_division_id,',') )
  AND    CASE WHEN @p_scm_site_id = 'ALL' THEN @p_division_id			
                        ELSE A.SCM_SITE_ID
 	               END  IN ( SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_scm_site_id,',') )
